{"id":"project-LICHEN-1www.61","title":"struct in6_addr fallback definition may conflict with system headers","description":"Location: firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/ipv6_addr.h:43-65 (struct in6_addr detection and fallback)

Risk: The detection logic checks various header guards (IN6ADDR_ANY_INIT, _NETINET_IN_H, etc.) to determine if struct in6_addr is already defined. If a new platform uses a different guard or includes the system header after ipv6_addr.h, the fallback definition at line 62-64 conflicts.

The comment acknowledges this: If this conflicts with your platform struct in6_addr, define LICHEN_HAVE_IN6_ADDR=1 before including this header.

Pattern generating user issue reports: New platform port includes system header after ipv6_addr.h, gets struct redefinition error.

Suggested fix: The current approach (checking common guards + user override) is reasonable, but could be improved by:
1. Using a typedef to a uniquely-named struct internally: struct lichen_in6_addr { uint8_t s6_addr[16]; }; typedef struct lichen_in6_addr lichen_in6_addr_t;
2. Then conditionally typedef struct in6_addr lichen_in6_addr_t or define lichen_in6_addr_t as the custom struct
3. All internal code uses lichen_in6_addr_t

This eliminates the possibility of struct redefinition.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-06-27T21:46:50.650179Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-06-27T22:03:33.743851Z","closed_at":"2026-06-27T22:03:33.743851Z","close_reason":"fixed","labels":["maintainer-burden","owner-reserved","review","risk"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-1www.61","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-1www","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-06-27T21:46:50.650714Z"}]}

new_value: Dedup: reconciled with rwio.57 and 0zj6.29 into ONE fix. Note: path moved since filing - live header is lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h (firmware/bridge-zephyr no longer vendors the header; its CMake only adds that dir for includes and its vendored subsys is not compiled, enforced by test_bridge_zephyr_does_not_compile_vendored_lichen_sources). Rewrote the in6_addr provisioning cascade: keep LICHEN_HAVE_IN6_ADDR override; __ZEPHYR__ now includes <zephyr/net/net_ip.h> unconditionally (struct defined at net_ip.h:143 with no CONFIG_NET_IPV6 gate in Zephyr 4.1.0); otherwise __has_include(<netinet/in.h>) INCLUDES the real header (order-independent via system include guards), eliminating the fragile guard-macro list (glibc/musl/bionic/newlib/BSD/Darwin all covered by construction); bare-metal fallback defines struct in6_addr only when neither Zephyr nor POSIX headers exist. Zero API churn - call sites keep struct in6_addr. Verified: 4-mode clang -fsyntax-only matrix (POSIX incl-order independence, stub-Zephyr both orders, -nostdinc bare-metal fallback with _Static_assert(sizeof==16), user override) all clean with -Werror; host cmake test pubkey_to_iid (compiles this header + ipv6_addr.c, UBSan) passed; real Zephyr 4.1.0 west build of tests/icmpv6 for nrf52840dk (SDK 0.16.8) linked 153/153 with the new cascade; cppcheck no new findings. See also 0zj6.29 (hack deletion) and rwio.57 (same root cause).
